exports.name: FramePhase
exports.description:
Frame scheduler (contracts/core-engine.md §1, ADR 0018 §3).

One `requestAnimationFrame` loop shared by every effect. Each frame runs three phases in a fixed
order so effects never interleave layout reads with style writes (no layout thrashing):

  read   — measure (getBoundingClientRect, scroll positions)
  update — advance springs and timelines (pure computation)
  write  — apply styles (transform, custom properties)

A task runs once per frame while it returns `true`; returning anything else removes it. Tasks
added to a later phase during a frame run in that same frame; tasks added to the current or an
earlier phase run in the next frame. The loop stops requesting frames when no task is pending,
so an idle page costs nothing. On the server (no `requestAnimationFrame`) scheduling is a no-op.

props.name: schedule
props.description: Queue `task` in `phase` (default `"update"`); returns an idempotent cancel function.

props.name: size
props.description: Number of pending tasks (diagnostics and tests).

props.name: maxDelta
props.description: Upper bound of `delta` in seconds (default 1/15) so a background tab never "jumps".

exports.name: FrameTask
exports.description: Return `true` to run again on the next frame; any other value (or none) ends the task.

exports.name: ReducedMotion
exports.description:
Reduced-motion policy (contracts/accessibility.md, constitution IV).

- `"user"` (default everywhere): follow `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- `"always"`: always use the reduced variant (e.g. an application-level "reduce motion" setting).
- `"never"`: ignore the preference. Reserved for motion essential to the meaning (WCAG 2.3.3);
  effects in this package never default to it.

exports.name: SpringOptions
exports.description:
Damped spring integrator (contracts/core-engine.md §2).

Pure and framework-agnostic: the caller owns the state object and the clock. Semi-implicit Euler
with fixed sub-steps (at most 1/240 s) keeps the integration stable for any frame rate; the
spring snaps to its target once both the distance and the speed fall below the rest thresholds,
so an idle effect stops scheduling frames.

props.name: damping
props.description: Damping coefficient c (default 26). `c >= 2 * sqrt(k * m)` never overshoots.

props.name: mass
props.description: Mass m (default 1).

props.name: restDelta
props.description: Distance below which the spring may rest (default 0.01, in the value's unit).

props.name: restSpeed
props.description: Speed below which the spring may rest (default 0.01 units/s).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring constant k (default 170). Higher is faster.

exports.name: TransformLayer
exports.description:
Transform composition (contracts/composition.md, ADR 0018 §4).

Several effects may move the same element. Instead of each effect writing `transform` (last
write wins), JavaScript-driven effects contribute *layers* to the element's motion host (host.ts),
which writes one composed `transform` per frame through its style ledger. CSS-driven effects use the individual
`translate` / `rotate` / `scale` properties, which the browser applies before `transform`, so
both kinds coexist without conflicts.

Rules (deterministic and independent of layer order):
- translations add (px); rotations add per axis (deg); scales multiply (`scale` with `scaleX`/`scaleY`,
  Phase 012, additive; written as `scale(x, y)` only when non-uniform);
- `perspective` takes the smallest positive value (the strongest perspective wins);
- skews add per axis (deg; Phase 011, additive);
- output order: perspective, translate3d, rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ, skew, scale (CSS order);
- identity parts are omitted; the identity composition is `"none"`.
Summing per-axis rotations is exact for one rotating layer and a close approximation for
several small rotations (3D rotations do not commute); documented, not hidden.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective distance in px (applied first).

props.name: rotateX
props.description: Degrees.

props.name: scale
props.description: Uniform scale factor.

props.name: scaleX
props.description: Horizontal scale factor (Phase 012, multiplies with `scale`).

props.name: scaleY
props.description: Vertical scale factor (Phase 012, multiplies with `scale`).

props.name: skewX
props.description: Degrees (Phase 011, SP11).

props.name: skewY
props.description: Degrees (Phase 011, SP11).
